body_lead: Mumbai: Chief minister Devendra Fadnavis on Monday launched the Mahachatur AI Chatbot which will provide skill training, employment, entrepreneurship and guidance to the youth of the state on a single platform. The launch ceremony was held at the Sahyadri state guest house. It is a transformative initiative for Maharashtra, said the CM. Developed under the initiative of the Department of Skill, Employment, Entrepreneurship and Innovation, this chatbot is the first of its kind by the state government in the country.
